items.q: And Lord and Miss Claudia had just come out, and I sang Lord and Miss Claudia

ctx.x: And Lord and Miss Claudia had just come out, and I sang Lord and Miss Claudia, and Miss Woman kept sending me five dollar bills up there to sing Lord and Miss Claudia.
